data.title: 阿尔法 · 四越盛典的暗夜花火
data.description: 四越商会日式庭园回廊前，盛装的阿尔法手扶木质栏杆远眺高空绽放的漫天花火，红纸灯笼光辉照映黑金暗椿浴衣。
data.location: traditional wooden veranda terrace overlooking a sprawling festival garden
data.action: standing gracefully leaning against veranda railing, gazing sideways at bursting fireworks in night sky, soft nostalgic smile
data.lighting: 花火高光与红纸灯笼暖光
data.promptProse: Alpha in a dark yukata stands at a quiet wooden veranda, watching vibrant fireworks burst in the night sky as red lanterns cast a warm glow.
data.animaCaption: Fireworks illuminate her golden hair as she leans softly against the wooden railing.
